contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount:Real): Boolean {
          definition:
          currentStore:Store = Store.allInstances()->any(store:Store | store.Sales->includes(self.CurrentSale))
            
            precondition:
          self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and self.CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and amount >= self.CurrentSale.Amount
            
            postcondition:
          let payment:CashPayment in payment.oclIsNew() and CashPayment.allInstances()->includes(payment) and Payment.allInstances()->includes(payment) and payment.AmountTendered = amount and payment.Balance = amount - self.CurrentSale.Amount@pre and payment.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale and self.CurrentSale.AssoicatedPayment = payment and self.CurrentSale.Belongedstore = currentStore and self.CurrentSale.Time = Now and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and result = true
            
        }

errors.msg: extraneous input 'if' expecting {'self', 'result', 'true', 'false', 'null', 'Set', RULE_DOUBLE_QUOTED_STRING, RULE_SINGLE_QUOTED_STRING, RULE_ID, RULE_INT}

contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid:String,barcode:String): Boolean {
          definition:
          targetUser:User = User.allInstances()->any(candidate:User | candidate.UserID = uid), targetCopy:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(candidate:BookCopy | candidate.Barcode = barcode), targetStudent:Student = Student.allInstances()->any(candidate:Student | candidate.UserID = uid), targetFaculty:Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(candidate:Faculty | candidate.UserID = uid), matchingReservation:Reserve = Reserve.allInstances()->any(candidate:Reserve | candidate.ReservedUser = targetUser and candidate.ReservedCopy = targetCopy and candidate.IsReserveClosed = false)
            
            precondition:
          User.allInstances()->exists(candidate:User | candidate.UserID = uid) and BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(candidate:BookCopy | candidate.Barcode = barcode) and targetUser.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and targetUser.SuspensionDays = 0 and (if targetUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) then if targetStudent.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR then targetUser.LoanedNumber < 20 else if targetStudent.Programme = Programme::MASTER then targetUser.LoanedNumber < 40 else targetUser.LoanedNumber < 60 endif endif else if targetUser.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) then targetUser.LoanedNumber < 60 else false endif endif) and (targetCopy.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE or (targetCopy.Status = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF and targetCopy.IsReserved = true and Reserve.allInstances()->exists(candidate:Reserve | candidate.ReservedUser = targetUser and candidate.ReservedCopy = targetCopy and candidate.IsReserveClosed = false)))
            
            postcondition:
          let newLoan:Loan in newLoan.oclIsNew() and Loan.allInstances()->includes(newLoan) and newLoan.LoanedUser = targetUser and newLoan.LoanedCopy = targetCopy and targetUser.LoanedBook->includes(newLoan) and targetCopy.LoanedRecord->includes(newLoan) and newLoan.LoanDate = Today and newLoan.IsReturned = false and newLoan.DueDate = if targetUser.oclIsTypeOf(Student) then Today.After(30) else Today.After(60) endif and targetUser.LoanedNumber = targetUser.LoanedNumber@pre + 1 and targetCopy.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and newLoan.OverDue3Days = false and newLoan.OverDue10Days = false and newLoan.OverDue17Days = false and newLoan.OverDue31Days = false and (if targetCopy.Status@pre = CopyStatus::ONHOLDSHELF then targetCopy.IsReserved = false and matchingReservation.IsReserveClosed = true else true endif) and result = true
            
        }
